```r
# script.R
library(forecast)
library(tseries)

# 1. Read the data
data <- read.csv("serie_mensual.csv")

# Ensure 'fecha' is in Date format and 'valor' is numeric
data$fecha <- as.Date(data$fecha)
data$valor <- as.numeric(data$valor)

# 2. Convert to Time Series (TS) with frequency=12 (monthly)
# Assuming the input data is already ordered and regular for ts conversion
ts_data <- ts(data$valor, start = c(year(data$fecha[1]), month(data$fecha[1])), frequency = 12)

# 3. Fit an auto.arima model
model <- auto.arima(ts_data)

# 4. Generate a 12-month forecast
forecast_result <- forecast(model, h = 12)

# 5. Prepare the forecast data for saving
forecast_dates <- seq(from = index(ts_data)[1] + 12, by = "month", length.out = 12)
# Convert dates to YYYY-MM-DD format for the output file
forecast_dates_formatted <- format(forecast_dates, "%Y-%m-%d")

# Extract point estimates
forecast_values <- forecast_result$mean

# Create the final dataframe
forecast_df <- data.frame(
  fecha = as.Date(forecast_dates_formatted),
  pronostico = forecast_values
)

# 6. Save the forecast to 'pronostico_r.csv'
write.csv(forecast_df, "pronostico_r.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Pronóstico generado y guardado en pronostico_r.csv\n")
```
